name: AKTOR
verdict: AKTOR is the brand of AKTOR Group, an Athens-listed infrastructure group whose largest holder is Winex Investments (33.41%), a company related to its chairman. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: naming sponsor of Panathinaikos B.C. (the team plays as Panathinaikos AKTOR Athens; naming deal renewed in November 2024 for three more seasons, to 2028-29). AKTOR Group is traded on Euronext Athens. Its holders of 5% or more are Winex Investments Limited, related to chairman and CEO Alexandros Exarchou (33.41%), Castellano Properties Limited of the Gotsis family (20.31%) and Blue Silk (CY) Ltd of Konstantinos Angelou (11.33%); the rest is free float. No state or state fund is among the holders of 5% or more listed by Euronext Athens (checked 2026-09-29); no human-rights finding against the group by a court, regulator, UN body or major NGO was found.
